The inner world was vast and mighty.

Spatial Layers were being rapidly opened and derived one after another.

Lin Yuan felt it briefly and deduced the current number of Spatial Layers his inner world occupied.

One hundred and twenty million Spatial Layers.

In the Main World Prime Universe, Ninth Rank lifeforms, also known as Multi-Spatial Life, need to occupy as many Spatial Layers as possible.

...

But one hundred and twenty million Spatial Layers… Lin Yuan did not know if, throughout the ancient history of the Main World, there had ever been a Ninth Rank life that had opened such a number of Spatial Layers.

But Lin Yuan had never heard of it.

The vast majority of Ninth Rank lifeforms, after exhausting all their efforts, only managed to open up ten million Spatial Layers, and a few managed to reach twenty or thirty million Spatial Layers at most.

Perhaps certain unique and unparalleled special lifeforms might aspire to open seventy or eighty million Spatial Layers?

But more than one hundred million Spatial Layers? Or one hundred and twenty million? It’s not that it wasn’t feasible to open them, but normal Ninth Rank lifeforms simply did not have the lifespan to do so.

Even Lin Yuan achieved such a feat in a short time only thanks to the special properties of the ‘Divine Lattice’ in this world.

“Just about there,” he said.

“It’s time to try for the True Divine Nature as well as the True God Form.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the void, as if seeing through the numerous Spatial Layers, his gaze falling upon the expansive Spatial Layers of the Ocean of Light and the dark abyss.

At this thought, Lin Yuan actively left the Longshan Great Hall.

“Patriarch.”

“The Patriarch has come out of seclusion.”

Several members of the Longshan Family had long been waiting outside; they had heard the unbelievable news and had gathered immediately outside the Longshan Great Hall.

“Ayuan,” the Longshan Fang Couple looked at Lin Yuan, wanting to say something but not knowing where to start.

The current Lin Yuan gave the same impression as before; it was somewhat difficult for them to connect him with the Longshan Patriarch who killed True God Incarnations as if squashing ants.

“Patriarch, did you really kill those True God Incarnations?” Longshan Ling finally couldn’t help but ask, “Is what the Rank Pope said true?”

“Indeed, I killed them,” Lin Yuan nodded. With his inner world’s Spatial Layers reaching one hundred and twenty million, he was even confident enough to go up against Tenth Rank Life, hand to hand.

In this region of the sky and earth, he was unmatched and unstoppable.

“It really was the Patriarch who killed them.”

“The Patriarch was able to kill such numerous True God Incarnations; he must possess the strength to kill a True God as well.”

Upon hearing this, the hearts of the other Longshan Family members began to tremble. Learning of this matter from others was completely different from hearing it from their own Patriarch.

“Is our Longshan Family going to become a Divine Spirit family?” tears brimmed in the eyes of many elderly members of the Longshan Family.

In the Plateau of Myriad Nations, there exist some transcendental forces that are above empires, namely families that have given birth to True Gods.

These families are the ones that rank just below the various major churches, and they are even often the focus of True Gods who ascend to the Ocean of Light.

Now.

The Longshan Family was also about to join their ranks.

This was more shocking than when Lin Yuan previously announced his Demigod powers to the outside world; in this land, a True God signifies eternal glory.

Lin Yuan glanced at the excited and exhilarated Longshan Family members, smiling, “I’m now going to the Ocean of Light.”

“Going to the Ocean of Light?” Longshan Ling realized then that their Patriarch was not an ordinary True God.

According to the Rank Pope, the Longshan Patriarch had not yet established a Divine Kingdom, but he possessed almost invincible True God strength.

“Patriarch, what are you going to do in the Ocean of Light?” Longshan Ling hesitated before finally working up the courage to ask.

“I’m going to negotiate a trade with the gods,” Lin Yuan didn’t hide anything and spoke directly.

The trade Lin Yuan was going to discuss with the gods involved them willingly offering up their Divine Lattices, which he would understand in turn and could give back to them.

Indeed, if the gods were willing to cooperate, Lin Yuan could absolutely give them some dignity.

“Negotiate a trade?” Longshan Ling swallowed hard; she noted that Lin Yuan was not speaking of a specific True God, but the gods!

What did that imply?

Longshan Ling did not dare contemplate it further.

The other Longshan Family members, however, did not delve into the details; they were still immersed in the joy of the Longshan Family soon becoming a Divine Spirit family.

…

Slit, slash.

Lin Yuan took a step forward.

The stable space in front suddenly ‘ripped’ open a crack, and a vast world filled with endless light emerged.

That was the Ocean of Light.

Lin Yuan continued stepping forward, entering the Ocean of Light.

Immediately, the crack closed rapidly, leaving behind the Longshan Family members with shocked expressions.

This was also the first time for these ordinary people to see the true sight of the Ocean of Light, a place desired by countless Demigods to glimpse just once, had so easily appeared before everyone.

…

At the Ocean of Light.

Vast and expansive, filled with the breath of endless light.

“Light?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes narrowed slightly; it was said that the very first Prime God in this world was the Main God of Light, controlling all the light in the world.

Just as Lin Yuan entered the Ocean of Light.

In the sanctuary where the twenty-four Prime Gods gathered, the face of the Main God of Light changed slightly.

“The Longshan Patriarch has arrived at the Ocean of Light,” the Main God of Light declared immediately.

The Ocean of Light was created by him, and the Main God of Light had complete control over every subtle change in it.

“What?”

“That Longshan Patriarch actually dares to come here on his own?”

“We were just thinking of how to lure the Longshan Patriarch here, and now he’s shown up himself?”

The remaining twenty-three Prime Gods were somewhat incredulous but quickly realized this presented an unprecedented opportunity.

The Longshan Patriarch was unaware of their true combined strength, which is why he dared to come of his own volition.

“I have sealed off the Ocean of Light; now all Divine Spirits, including us Prime Gods, are unable to leave for a short time.”
